	location:granada.owner ?= root
}

tv_vw_unique_alhambra_present_here_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			this = location:granada
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_alhambra_inaugurated value >= $ed_level$ }
		}
		OR = {
			any_work_of_art_in_location = { this ?= work_of_art:alhambra_palace }
			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:alhambra value >= $vanilla_level$ }
		}
	}
}
